verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party keyboard shortcuts help article, though the pack gives only its title, and a community user cites its 'better web shortcuts' as a reason to switch from Gmail. Users describe the web UI as responsive and fast, with some reports of view reloads and slower search. Missing for 10: any evidence of a command palette, documented breadth of shortcut coverage (whether everything can be done from the keyboard), and consistent speed corroboration (reports of reloads and slower search).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: Fastmail is way more responsive and fluid and feels almost native
Fastmail was a ton faster and didn't randomly forget my sessions.
